name: components-community-share-button

frames.best_why: The hover state shows the GitHub, X and Facebook icons fully risen inside the button.

tagline: Hovering swaps the Share label for GitHub, X and Facebook icons.
summary: A wide pale button showing a share glyph and the word Share; on hover the label slides away and three social icons pop up in its place, each lifting when pointed at.
appearance: A wide, rounded rectangle of pale grey on a near-black stage, with a black share glyph and the word Share centred inside. Swapped, the same surface holds three black icons spaced in a row.
behaviour: On hover the label slides up and fades out while the three icons spring up from below; leaving reverses it. Each icon also jumps a little higher when the pointer reaches it.
demo_content: The word Share, with GitHub, X and Facebook icons.
search_phrases: button that reveals social icons on hover
sharing control with github and x
share post to facebook and twitter
wide pill button with share arrow
use_when: A button should offer several share destinations without opening a menu or modal.
avoid_when: Touch has no hover, so the platform icons stay hidden until a tap, which also counts as the share.
customise: The label comes in as children, and size, icon side and a per-platform callback are props; the three platforms and their icons are fixed in source.
weight_why: One button with a short slide and three icons; idle when not hovered.

a11y.note: The platform icons are clickable divs with no role or label that appear only on hover, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot use them.

issues: The platform icons are unlabeled clickable divs, so they are unreachable by keyboard.
The main button has no click action of its own, so clicking the Share label does nothing.
polish_why: Crisp swap and a springy icon reveal; unlabeled divs and a dead base click hold it back.
title: Share Button
